This interactive dashboard contains information about food access for higher educational institutions in Erie County, NY.

## Data Sources

NYSED Higher Education Institution Directory\
[**NYSED Erie County profile**](https://data.nysed.gov/profile.php?county=14)\
*New York State Education Department*

The institution list is extracted from the higher education institutions section of NYSED's Erie County profile. Institutions listed in the separate closed institutions section are excluded. The extraction is run separately in RStudio. This webpage displays the saved Markdown table; rendering the website does not refresh the institution list.

Geography: Erie County, New York
